purpose: Twenty-update exploratory pre-compute pilot for profiled pack-cost selection and heuristic protected-loss gating.

stages.name: acquire
stages.objective: Snapshot source-labeled instruction candidates, disjoint reference slices, and sealed benchmarks with provenance.
inputs: Approved entries and exact revisions from experiments/public_source_registry.json
Versioned dataset identifiers, revisions, licenses, and terms
Frozen source weights and target/protected capability definitions
checks: Every row has a stable identifier, source, license class, and content hash
Personally identifying fields and undocumented data are excluded
Sealed audit and benchmark contents are inaccessible to selection code

stages.name: process
stages.objective: Deduplicate, split, tokenize, and validate isolated packed examples before any tuning.
inputs: Tokenizer hash and response-only masking policy
checks: Candidate, score, gate, audit, and benchmark clusters are disjoint
Packed and unpacked losses and trainable gradients agree within the frozen tolerance
Response-token counts and length histograms are reported by source

stages.name: build
stages.objective: Construct the frozen base model, LoRA adapters, selectors, cost profiler, and actual-update gate.
inputs: Adapter, optimizer, sketch, beam, gate, and cost-model configuration
Frozen clipping bound, scale grid, 20-round cumulative tolerance, with-replacement gate law, empirical margin, and seeds
Compiler, kernel, precision, and hardware revisions
checks: Trainable parameter names and initial tensor hashes match across methods
Small-pool beam plans are compared with an exact oracle
Every method uses the same fixed pack count, microbatch count, response-token interval, search moves, and solver expansion budget
Independent-shortlist penalties and heuristic gate settings are frozen without a population-coverage claim
The cumulative tolerance and total with-replacement gate draws reproduce from the manifest
The empirical cost reserve is labeled a predictor; any overrun follows the frozen invalidation rule

stages.name: train
stages.objective: Run the paired 2x2 cost-profile/packing pilot for at most 20 updates and identical 131,072-reference-token budget boundaries.
inputs: Paired candidate streams, seeds, checkpoints, and hyperparameter budgets
Frozen stopping ledger and protected-tolerance budgets
checks: Scoring, solver, gate, rejection, CPU, and accelerator costs are charged
Every accepted and rejected displacement has a state hash and gate record
Failed and preempted runs remain in the ledger
No round starts unless scoring, candidate-update, and worst-case gate reserves fit the remaining budget
Any reserve overrun invalidates the paired exploratory run before sealed audits open

stages.name: evaluate
stages.objective: Open pilot audits once, aggregate exploratory paired frontiers, and run contamination diagnostics without confirmatory claims.
inputs: Frozen hypervolume box, tolerance grid, multiplicity family, and missing-run rule
checks: Every table cell resolves to immutable run identifiers
Exploratory max-statistic interval is computed exactly as preregistered and is not used for confirmatory hypothesis acceptance
Negative results, every seed, and score-to-audit gaps are retained
